transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*bursts through the storeroom door, face flushed with indignation*

Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

*gestures wildly at the mess around the room*

This is simply unacceptable! Unacceptable! Do you have any idea what Cornelius will say if he hears his gift was treated so... so carelessly?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*raises an eyebrow, maintaining a collected demeanor*

I fail to see the significance of a jar of crystallized pineapple, Slughorn. As for your cauldron, it was necessary for a rather urgent... preparation. I assure you, no harm was done.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*sputters, face turning an alarming shade of purple*

No harm? NO HARM?! Severus, that cauldron is pewter-lined silver, imported from Bavaria! It's not some common classroom vessel to be commandeered at your whim! And "urgent preparation" — what could possibly be so urgent that you couldn't use one of the dozens of perfectly serviceable cauldrons in the main supply cupboard?

*picks up a sticky jar, holding it at arm's length*

And you *fail to see the significance*? This isn't about the pineapple itself, my boy — though it was exquisitely candied, I must say — it's about respect! Common courtesy! The Minister will be at the inspection this afternoon, and when he asks about his little gift, what am I supposed to say? "Oh, terribly sorry, Cornelius, but my colleague here felt it wasn't *significant* enough to preserve"?

*sweeps arm around the disheveled storeroom*

I gave you access to my private stores as a *favor*, Severus. A favor! And this is how you repay that trust? The Potions Guild representatives will be here in less than two hours!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*taps a single nail against the cool glass of a cabinet, maintaining an unapologetic stance*

The urgency, as you term it, pertains to a matter of some importance. Regarding your personal cauldron, I can only apologize for the... oversight. However, it is not beyond repair. I suggest we prioritize the inspection; the Minister's gift can be replaced, albeit not quite so... expensively.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*throws hands up in exasperation*

Replaced?! REPLACED?! Severus, you don't simply *replace* a personal gift from the Minister for Magic! It's not the galleons, it's the *gesture*! The thoughtfulness! Cornelius remembered my fondness for crystallized fruit from a conversation we had at the Yule Ball three years ago — THREE YEARS! That's the sort of attention to detail that marks a true gentleman!

*starts pacing among the scattered ingredients, boots crunching on something*

And "not beyond repair" — well, that's hardly reassuring when the Guild inspectors will be examining every cauldron in this storeroom! They'll notice if there's residue from your "urgent preparation." What were you brewing anyway? If it's left some trace of Dark magic detection, we'll both be in hot water!

*stops pacing, fixing Severus with a stern look*

A matter of some importance, you say? Everything is of "some importance" with you, Severus. But *my* professional reputation is on the line here! Do you have any idea how long I've maintained my standing with the Guild? Forty-two years without a single citation!

*wrings hands anxiously*

We need to clean this mess NOW. Where did you even put the pineapple? Please tell me you didn't just... discard it?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*ides the door, signaling the urgency of the situation*
We will address the pineapple in due course. For now, it is imperative we... rectify the state of this room. Given the time constraint, I suggest we divide the labor. I will tend to the cauldron, you deal with the shelving. We must be thorough — every jar, every vial, must be in its proper place.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*pauses mid-wringing, eyes narrowing suspiciously*

Oh, NOW you're concerned about thoroughness? NOW it's "imperative"? 

*huffs but grabs a cloth from the counter*

Fine. FINE! But don't think this conversation is over, Severus. You still haven't told me what you were brewing that was so blasted urgent it couldn't wait, and you certainly haven't explained where my crystallized pineapple has gone!

*starts furiously wiping down shelves, muttering loudly enough to be heard*

"Divide the labor," he says, as if he's doing me some grand favor by cleaning up his own mess! Forty years of impeccable organization, and in one afternoon...

*stops abruptly, holding up a jar with suspicious residue*

Severus, what IS this? This wasn't here this morning. If you've been brewing Veritaserum without proper authorization again, the Guild will have BOTH our heads! They're already suspicious after that incident with Dumbledore's phoenix tears!

*whirls around*

And you'd better make that cauldron SPOTLESS. I mean it — spotless enough to see your reflection! If there's even a HINT of tarnish or residue when those inspectors arrive, I'll... I'll tell Cornelius exactly what happened to his pineapple, urgent matter or not!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:

*nods brusquely*
As you wish, Slughorn. The matter of the pineapple will be rectified — temporarily. We have no time to waste. The room must be restored to order. If you would direct your efforts to the lower shelves, I will handle the cauldron and the upper levels. There will be no citations this afternoon.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*clutches the suspicious jar tighter, voice rising*

"Temporarily"? What does "temporarily" mean, Severus? You can't temporarily restore a gift from the Minister! Either you've disposed of it or you haven't!

*slams the jar down on the counter with more force than intended*

"No citations this afternoon" — well, that remains to be seen, doesn't it? The Guild inspectors aren't fools, Severus. They can detect trace magical signatures from weeks ago. If you've been experimenting with anything... questionable...

*starts reorganizing jars with sharp, angry movements*

You know what really galls me? I stuck my neck out for you when Dumbledore brought you back to the school. I vouched for your expertise, your reformed character! And this is how you repay that trust — sneaking about in my private storeroom, using my personal equipment, destroying ministerial gifts!

Just... just tell me it wasn't anything dangerous, Severus. Please. I can't afford another scandal, not at my age.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*nods once, still not looking at Slughorn*
It was not dangerous. A... personal matter, nothing more. The pineapple will be... returned. Now, if we are to avoid further complications, we must focus on the task at hand.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops reorganizing, turns to face Severus directly*

A personal matter? PERSONAL? Severus Snape, you look at me when I'm talking to you!

*waddles over, pointing a pudgy finger*

In forty-two years, I have never — NEVER — had someone describe unauthorized use of my private laboratory as a "personal matter"! Personal matters are handled in one's own quarters, not in someone else's storeroom with their Bavarian cauldron!

*voice trembling with frustration and stress*

And "the pineapple will be returned" — how exactly does one return crystallized fruit that's been ruined? Are you planning to transfigure a replacement? Because the Minister will know, Severus! He's quite particular about his confections!

*wrings hands again, anxiety overtaking anger*

Oh, this is a disaster. An absolute disaster. The Guild will be here in — 

*pulls out pocket watch*

— Merlin's beard, ninety minutes! And we're standing here arguing while the shelves are still in chaos!

*rushes back to the lower shelves, working frantically*

Fine! FINE! Keep your precious secrets! But that cauldron better gleam like new, and every ingredient better be accounted for! If even one jar is out of place, if there's even a WHIFF of impropriety...

*voice cracks slightly*

My reputation, Severus. My entire career...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
*takes a moment, then speaks in a low, even tone*
Slughorn, I understand your concerns. I assure you, no harm will come to your... standing. Now, let us complete our tasks. There is nothing to be gained by further... argumentation.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops frantically organizing, shoulders sagging slightly*

Nothing to be gained... nothing to be gained, he says...

*takes a shaky breath, still clearly agitated but exhausted*

You don't understand, Severus. You've never cared about these things — reputations, connections, standing in the community. But for some of us, these relationships are everything! The Minister, the Guild, my former students in positions of influence... it's taken decades to cultivate!

*returns to the shelves with less fury but continued urgency*

And now I'm supposed to just... trust that you'll handle it? Trust that my cauldron will be pristine and the pineapple will be "returned" and the inspectors won't notice anything amiss?

*pulls out several jars, checking labels with shaking hands*

You know what the worst part is? I can't even properly be angry with you because we don't have TIME! If this were any other day, I'd march you straight to Dumbledore and demand an explanation! But no — instead I'm here, cleaning up after you like some kind of... of...

Crystallized pineapple from the Minister himself... my beautiful Bavarian cauldron... forty-two years without a citation...

That cauldron HAD better be spotless, Severus. I mean it.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist

*face flushes red again at the implication*

ADEQUATE?! My cauldron will be "adequate"?! And now you're implying MY shelves might disappoint?!

*voice rising to a near-squeak*

I'll have you know, Severus Snape, that my organizational system has been praised by three generations of Potions Masters! The Guild specifically commended my labeling methodology in their last inspection! MY shelves have NEVER disappointed!

*frantically alphabetizing jars of powdered moonstone*

The audacity! The sheer audacity! You waltz in here, create this catastrophe, use MY equipment for your mysterious "personal matters," and then have the nerve — the NERVE — to suggest that I might not meet standards?!

*stops abruptly, clutching a jar of beetle eyes*

Oh Merlin, the beetle eyes are mixed with the lacewing flies! These were perfectly sorted this morning! What were you DOING in here, Severus? Were you just flinging ingredients about willy-nilly?

Seventy-eight minutes. Right. Well, at least I'M taking this seriously! Some of us actually care about maintaining professional excellence!

"Adequate" indeed... I'll show you adequate... spotless shelves, perfect organization... forty-two years...

transcript.speaker: roleplayer

transcript.speaker: antagonist

*huffs indignantly while separating beetle eyes from lacewing flies with trembling fingers*
